user.title: Connect to a BlissLights projector
user.description: Select a discovered device, or enter its Bluetooth MAC address if it wasn't found automatically.

credentials.title: Mesh credentials
credentials.description: The factory-default mesh credentials didn't work for {address} -- this usually means the device was re-paired with custom values via the official app's QR-share feature. Enter those custom values here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Make sure it's powered on and in range.
error.pairing_failed: Connected, but the pairing handshake failed. Double-check the mesh name/password.
error.invalid_vendor_id: Vendor ID must be a number, e.g. 0x0211 or 529.
